message.content:
Interesting! In `sopc_encoder.c`, the checks are `builtInTypeId <= 0 || builtInTypeId > SOPC_BUILTINID_MAX + 1` - this allows `builtInTypeId == SOPC_BUILTINID_MAX + 1` (i.e., 26), but the tables are sized `SOPC_BUILTINID_MAX + 1` (i.e., 26 elements, indices 0-25). So accessing index 26 would be out-of-bounds!

Let me look at the encoder.c code around lines 2129-2200 and 2550-2620 to understand the decode/encode paths.
